label: Thomas Aquinas, Summa theologiae I q.7 a.1… supports Every real determination of a being that is…
note: Q.7 a.1 co. says a form is limited by matter 'per hoc quod recipitur in materia' and that 'infinitum secundum quod se tenet ex parte formae non determinatae per materiam, habet rationem perfecti'; the claim states the resulting warrant for esse only. The statement extends it to every real determination of a being in which nothing is received, and adds that individuating principles, potencies and privations occur only in recipients; neither extension is in the passage.
